note: Cliff Hounds, 25 Nov 2026 (Darren: wild hounds without armour; the goblin camps' hounds in scrap armour with red eyes). The enemies sheet's form: faces right, 40x32 frames, feet (19,28), outline drawn in. 'hound' is the wild one already in the game, unchanged; 'scrap_hound' is new and has the same strips and frame counts. See README.md.

hound.note: The Cliff Hound: a lean grey wild dog with a black mane. Circles (move); crouch: rump up, chest down, tail up; then lunges with its jaws open.

scrap_hound.note: The goblins' war dog: the Cliff Hound with scrap strapped on (a rusted iron saddle plate, a spiked collar, a brow plate) and red eyes. Kept at the goblin camps and the Scrapyard. The same moves as the wild hound: circles (move); crouch; lunge with its jaws open.
